_comment: Declared blind spots of the quality defence, as measured by scripts/quality_matrix.py.
This file is a registry, not a to-do list: tests/test_quality_matrix.py fails when the
measured set of holes differs from the set declared here, in EITHER direction. A new
blind spot therefore cannot land silently - it has to be written down with an exit
criterion first - and a hole that gets closed cannot stay here as decoration, because
an obsolete entry reads as an open one.
Fields: id = '<kind>:<name>' exactly as measured; opened = date the measurement found
it; exit = the concrete, checkable state that removes it; why = one line of context.
QUALITY_MATRIX.md must list every id in this file and no others.
An empty list is a measured state, not an aspiration: the same gate that fails on an
unregistered hole fails on a registered one the measurement no longer reproduces.

holes.why: AGENTS.md forbids partial changelog updates, but scripts/check_changelog_mirrors.py compares version headers, which translation leaves identical, so an entry added to three mirrors and omitted from two passes it. Measured against root: docs/en carries one fewer [Unreleased] entry and docs/zh one fewer Added, one extra Changed and five fewer Fixed. The same blindness in placement form is what 401a8057 shipped: its entry landed above the preamble, inside the en and zh frontmatter, and before the first heading in ja and ko - invisible in all five bodies, green under every gate of the day.
holes.exit: scripts/check_changelog_mirrors.py exits non-zero when the five mirrors' [Unreleased] entry counts are not equal at every section position, which first needs the backfill: the missing Fixed entry in docs/en, the missing Added and five missing Fixed entries in docs/zh, and a ruling on the Changed bullet docs/zh holds that no other mirror has.
